item.title: DOJ investigation clouds future of Fed chair nomination
item.description: The future of the Federal Reserve's leadership is in limbo due to an investigation into current Fed Chair Jerome Powell that has prompted bipartisan backlash.

item.title: New Venture Escrow expands into Los Angeles

item.title: Gen X, millennials set to inherit trillions in real estate wealth

item.title: New bill seeks elimination of capital gains tax on home sales
